Integrate with your player

const base = 'https://ikymory.github.io/anime-subtitles-kazakh';
const response = await fetch(`${base}/api/v1/anime/frieren.json`);
if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${response.status}`);
const anime = await response.json();
for (const track of anime.subtitles) {
  if (track.files.vtt) console.log(track.episode, track.files.vtt);
}

Use returned URLs and track numbers. Counts do not imply a continuous episode range. A missing or unpublished format is null. Pages publishes canonical SRT/VTT; full self-hosted builds also include ASS. Historical source aliases remain in Git.

For cross-origin HTML5 subtitles, set crossorigin="anonymous" on your video element and use the manifest's WebVTT URL. Check timing against your exact licensed video release.

Self-hosted HTTP API

python -m subtitle_api.build --output .build/catalog --no-copy-subtitles
python -m subtitle_api.stage --catalog .build/catalog --output .build/pages
python -m subtitle_api.validate --directory .build/pages
python -m subtitle_api.server --directory .build/pages --port 8000

Requires Python 3.11+ and Git. Stage into an empty directory. Use --base-url on the builder to target your own origin. The portal resolves local asset paths automatically.

GET /api/v1/anime?q=frieren&genre=Fantasy&limit=24&offset=0
GET /api/v1/anime/frieren
GET /api/v1/stats
GET /health

Supports bounded search/filtering, pagination, GET/HEAD/OPTIONS, CORS, ETag caching, UTF-8 and JSON errors. Invalid query: 400. Unknown release: 404. Ambiguous numeric ID: 409. Writes: 405. The Python server is a local/reference server; use a production reverse proxy for TLS and capacity controls.

Coverage is a measurement

slug is the stable release key. Inherited numeric IDs and metadata are unverified; 70 numeric IDs match multiple entries. Static ambiguity documents contain error and matches with HTTP 200.

Available tracks are structurally usable after timestamp normalization or derivation from another format. 31 tracks are quarantined because safe timing recovery would require guessing. No complete-series or human-reviewed translation guarantee is made.

Each asset includes path, bytes, sha256, cues and origin. Preserve author attribution and consult the repository's existing license and rights policy.
